what: The build of apps/workspace before PL4 moved anything (ADR-152 R2, I11): what every later PL4 slice is compared against.

budget.what: The performance budget figures taken on the owner's Mac before PL4's slice E moved anything (ADR-152 I11; the owner's ruling of 20 November and file 014). Carried forward by dist_compare's re-record. The full paper is OspreyFlow_Build/process/lanes/v062/PL4_BUDGET_FIGURES_2026-11-22.md.
budget.taken: 08:21:07 to 08:23:03 UTC (a pause of 1 minute 56 seconds: no seat, no merge, no builder of the line running; load average 6.3 at the start)
budget.machine: the owner's Mac, with nothing else of the conductor's running (main checkout at 2f6388c: the code of PL4d3e's merge, f4d1634, plus docs-only commits)

commands.unit: npm run test:budget --workspace apps/workspace (vitest run --config vitest.budget.config.ts), three runs, from OspreyFlow_Core
commands.browser: OSPREY_PORTS_SLOT=25 npm run test:perf --workspace apps/workspace (playwright test --config perf/playwright.config.ts), two runs, the fixture of 50,000 nodes and 250,000 links under CI's software render, from OspreyFlow_Core

MatrixView.budget.test: src/matrix/MatrixView.budget.test.tsx: MatrixView at 50,000 nodes and 250,000 links opens inside the first-frame budget
MatrixView.budget.limit_is: elapsed < BUDGET_MS, asserted inside the test
MatrixView.budget.note: the figure is the whole test's duration as vitest prints it (set-up included); the test's own elapsed is under the limit; this is the tightest budget on the Mac, within a few percent of its limit

settledAnchor.budget.test: src/canvas/settledAnchor.budget.test.ts: settledAnchors at the perf fixture's size

perf_first_frame.test: perf.spec.ts: 50k/250k fixture to a first interactive frame

perf_sweep.test: perf.spec.ts: a sustained pan and zoom, average frame

long_frames.limit: none asserted; the profile is printed

community_links.test: community-links.spec.ts: a large working set opens grouped by community

browser.spread: about 12% between two runs on a quiet Mac (first frame 7,155 to 8,047 ms; sweep 1,588 to 1,885 ms per frame): beyond the budget's own tolerance means a figure outside the limits, or outside the spread of these runs by more than that noise
